selection: Five fixed existing search-seed clips selected before MuQ scores are inspected. No new mutation, caption search or automatic adoption.
comparison: Within-model rankings, action-minus-reflective margins, wording/window reversals and control failures. Cosine scales are not calibrated across models.
limitations: One previously inspected narrative scene and a CLAP-generated pool; not an unbiased model benchmark.
No human fit, enjoyment or distraction labels; no quality accuracy or personal preference established.
Only two correlated windows per clip and no fresh work/genre holdout.
No model training, large dataset, evolutionary expansion or runtime model dependency.
